info.title: MediusPA API
info.description:
This is the OpenAPI specification for MediusPA APIs. You are welcome to try the APIs below on your tenant. Remember to activate the OpenAPI test portal client application in Medius, for more information [click here](https://success.medius.com/documentation/integration-documentation/api_reference/specification/).

 Some useful links:
- [Success documentation](https://success.medius.com/documentation/integration-documentation/) - the complete API documentation
- [Postman collections](https://www.postman.com/medius-developers/medius-public-api) - Medius public API workspace

externalDocs.description: Find out more information in the success portal

post.summary: Submit a raw e-invoice file (XML or PDF) for asynchronous processing.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description: The global identifier of the company to submit the invoice for. Max 100 characters.

parameters.name: externalId
parameters.description: Optional external tracking identifier supplied by the caller. Max 100 characters.

202.description: Invoice successfully accepted for processing. Returns an import tracking identifier.

400.description: Invalid request (e.g. empty body, unknown company).

post.summary: Generate an e-invoice from structured JSON data in the specified format.

requestBody.description: Request body containing companyId, format, submit flag, optional external ID, and invoice data.

notes.content: Example : Indemnité forfaitaire pour frais de recouvrement de 40 euros due en cas de retard de paiement (art. L441-10 C. com.).
Example : Pénalités de retard exigibles le lendemain de la date d’échéance au taux annuel de 10%.
Example : Escompte : aucun escompte accordé pour paiement anticipé.

202.description: E-invoice successfully generated. Returns import tracking ID and base64-encoded invoice file.

400.description: Invalid request (validation error, unsupported format, or unknown company).

get.summary: Returns all network status messages in Pending state for the given company.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description: The global identifier of the company. Max 100 characters.

200.description: List of pending network status message URLs.

403.description: Forbidden - module not active for this tenant.

post.summary: Submit a network status update for an outbound invoice.

requestBody.description: Request body containing company identifier, invoice identifier, and status data.

201.description: Network status successfully submitted. Returns a message identifier.

400.description: Invalid request (validation error, unknown company, or invoice not found).

get.summary: Returns the full details of a single network status message.

put.summary: Marks a network status message as Processing, indicating the customer's system has started processing the update.

400.description: Invalid messageId (not a valid UUID) or unexpected state transition.

post.summary:
Marks a network status message as Succeeded, indicating the customer has finished processing the update.
The message must be in Pending or Processing state.

404.description: Network status message not found or invalid messageId.

post.summary:
Marks a network status message as Error, indicating the customer's system has failed to process the update.
The message must be in Pending or Processing state.

requestBody.description: Error details including the reason for failure.

400.description: Invalid request or unexpected state transition.

404.description: Network status message not found or invalid messageId.
